column3: In the very first episode, we learn why. When Naruto was a baby, a dangerous fox spirit was sealed inside him.
The adults knew. They were told never to talk about it. So they didn't. They just kept their distance. And their kids copied them, without even knowing why.
So Naruto does what a lot of lonely kids do. He gets loud. He paints all over the giant faces carved into the village mountain. Getting yelled at is better than being invisible.
And there's a moment fans never forget. After a test, the other kids run to their families. Naruto sits on a swing, by himself, watching.
